name: PeopleFinders

search.notes: The opt-out form locates the record from the details entered.

steps: Open the opt-out page, enter the name and email and complete the captcha yourself.
Open the email link within about 24 hours.
Fill the record form so it matches the listing, complete the second captcha and submit.
optout.notes: identity-eraser reports two captchas and a link that expires in about 24 hours, and says PeopleFinders is not part of PeopleConnect.

sources.attribution: California Privacy Protection Agency data broker registry, 2026 list fetched 2026-10-27

verification_note: Bot-blocked on 2026-10-27 (security challenge page), URL from nulltrace, identity-eraser and auto-identity-remove.
